nodes.description: Many mutant AQP0 proteins are retained in the endoplasmic reticulum or cytoplasm. Co-expression studies with E134G, T138R, a C-terminal frameshift (Delta213) and Y219* show that the mutant hetero-oligomerizes with and traps wild-type AQP0, a dominant-negative effect that lowers membrane AQP0 below the half dose a null allele would leave. Mouse Lop and Cat-Fr mutant AQP0 is likewise mistargeted away from the fiber cell plasma membrane in vivo.
nodes.id: AQP0 Mistrafficking and Endoplasmic Reticulum Retention

nodes.description: Mistrafficked mutant AQP0 adds a toxic component beyond loss of function. Lop/+ lenses activate the PERK-ATF4-DDIT3-CHAC1 branch of the unfolded protein response with glutathione depletion, free radical overproduction and calpain hyperactivation, and central fiber cells die. The Hfi and Cat-Tohm alleles act as dominant gain-of-function mutations, and the Nat allele causes fiber cell degeneration. This component is supported by mouse and cell data only; it has not been examined in patient lenses.

evidence.reference_title: Novel MIP gene mutation causes autosomal-dominant congenital cataract.

evidence.reference_title: The relationship between major intrinsic protein genes and cataract.

evidence.reference_title: The relationship between major intrinsic protein genes and cataract.

nodes.description: Reported alleles are mostly missense substitutions in the transmembrane and loop domains, plus frameshift, nonsense, splice-site and initiation codon variants.
